notes.title: 0.1.1b) Hotfix
notes.notes:
Patch contents

Fixed several incorrect Rana's trait values

Fixed the issue that Rana's traits counting stat-reward tokens as items

Tweaked the item pools in Quadrant 1 maps

Fixed an issue where a certain boss round did not function properly

notes.title: 0.0.1b) Perk Additions, Enemy Attack Type Additions, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

-The character selection screen has been added to the main menu, but it is not yet functional. We hope to activate it before the end of the month.

-The final remaining perk has been added, completing the default character’s perks (total 19 perks).

-New enemy ranged attack types have been implemented:
The red attack now is affected by Defense, while the new blue attack is affected by Resistance.

-The visibility of Auras has been adjusted.

-Fixed an issue where Auras were not fully applied; it seems some code was left unfinished in the previous patch.

-The Slime Stick now has an Aura that slows down enemy projectile speed.

-Tooltip visibility has been improved.

-Fixed an issue with ranged weapons where the attack count was not applied.

-Two new maps have been added to Quadrant 1. The enemy composition in these maps is temporary and will be revised in the next patch.


Bug Fixes:

-Fixed an issue from the previous patch: items that provided additional HP or ST increased only the maximum values at the start of a round, leaving the current HP/ST unchanged. This fix now works as intended.

-Fixed a bug that made progression impossible beyond the second map; this was resolved on Monday (2025.02.17).

-Fixed problems with translations malfunctioning.


Known Issues:

-There is an intermittent bug where item rewards or trade transactions sometimes fail to grant items. We are investigating the conditions causing this issue. In the meantime, moving an existing item within your inventory should allow you to receive the reward normally.
We aim to fix this by this Saturday (2025.02.22), though the root cause is not fully identified yet. Your patience is appreciated.

-There is a bug where if the inventory is full during item crafting, the crafted item is ejected outside of the inventory.


Next Patch (This Saturday, 2024.02.22):

-Further expansion of the Quadrant 1 map.

-Addition of new enemy types.

-Adding environmental hazards to maps (lower priority).


Planned Updates for February:

Resolution settings in Options ✅ (Completed)
FPS settings in Options ✅ (Completed)
Key Mapping ✅ (Completed)

Adding new items to default blueprints (In Progress)

Completion of Quadrant 1 (adding two bosses) ← At that point, the game version will be 0.0.2.
Addition of new blueprints.
Addition of new characters.


Thank you!

notes.title: 0.0.1b) Perk Additions, Temporary Items Completed, Bug Fixes, and More
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

-Item descriptions, sprites, and translations have been added for Gloves of Swiftness, Crystal Cape, and Cowl of Illusion.

-The Frozen Armor effect has been implemented.

-New perks for the default character have been added.


Bug Fixes:

-Fixed an issue where items that provide additional HP or ST would increase maximum HP/ST at the start of a round, but current HP/ST remained the same.

-Although it was not technically a bug, repeatedly acquiring the same World Core from a single map has been disabled.
Now, once the boss has been defeated, you cannot re-enter that map.
More bosses will be added soon, so we ask for your patience until then.


Known Issues:

There is an occasional bug where item rewards or trade transactions fail to grant items.
We are investigating the conditions that cause this issue. For now, if this happens, try moving an existing item inside your inventory—this should allow you to receive the reward properly.
We will try to fix this by next Saturday at the latest.


Next Patch (Next Wednesday, 2025.02.19):

-Further expansion of Quadrant 1 map

-Final perk addition for the default character (Only one left!)

-Additional damage types for enemy projectiles

-Fixing the issue where attack count does not apply to ranged weapons

-Adding environmental hazards to maps

-Slime Stick will finally have a function instead of being a useless item


Planned Updates for February:

-Resolution settings in Options ✅ (Completed)
-FPS settings in Options ✅ (Completed)
-Key Mapping ✅ (Completed)

-Adding new items to default blueprints (In Progress)

-Completing Quadrant 1 (adding two bosses) ← At this point, the game version will be 0.0.2.
-Adding new blueprints
-Adding new characters


Thank you!

notes.title: 0.0.1a) patch for this week
notes.notes:
I initially planned to complete the quadrant 2 map by the end of this week, but an urgent matter involving family business has come up, and I couldn’t finish it on time. It is expected to be completed within the next couple of days.


Patch Notes for This Update:

-Fixed various bugs related to item merging. From now on, there should be no more malfunctions concerning items.
-Made slight adjustments to map patterns, enemy patterns, and item rewards.



Next Patch Notes (Expected within two days):
(0.0.1b)

-Completion of quadrant 2 map (11 new maps added)
-Addition of 2–3 new perks
-Addition of stone-based items


Expected Patches by the End of This Month:

-Partial work on the quadrant 1 map
-Completion of all 19 perks for the default character
-Addition of dialogues
-Addition of a new playable character


Thank you.

notes.title: 0.0.1a - minor patch) Save file structure and starting map revised
notes.notes:
I found an issue with the save structure, so I fixed that and also made some minor tweaks to the map no.0.

The current playable map is half of the fourth quadrant.

I'll be releasing a patch next week that will complete the maps in the fourth quadrant, improve the item reward pool, and allow you to sell items in trade.

Thank you.
